CJP Leaders Accuse Centre of Imposing Emergency, Targeting Gen Z

Leaders of the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) have accused the central government of imposing an "undeclared emergency" and being afraid of the younger generation, referred to as "Gen Z." The accusations were made in the context of anticipated protests or actions by CJP in Delhi. Some reports also raised questions about potential "July replay fears," suggesting a concern about events repeating from July, and whether such concerns were an "overkill or legit."
